title: 成るか成らぬか“不動心”

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: Ngyaaah!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I'm walking through campus when I suddenly hear a shout that feels as if it's reverberating through the very ground.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: Pant, pant… T-Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: Well… Take a look at the floor.

text_block_list.name: Kittens
text_block_list.text: Mew. ♪ Purrr, purrr… ♪

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: I'm training my heart to remain still while these kittens cling to me.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: Every time I see something fragile and adorable, I'm overcome with a desire to protect it. I've been struggling with this weakness for as long as I can remember.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: Just the other day, I was so captivated by a kitten that I forgot to pick up my school bag when I left. It was utterly shameful.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: At this rate, I might end up making a critical mistake and failing to protect those who cannot fend for themselves.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: To remain so composed that even my excessive desire to protect remains in check—that is the goal I wish to accomplish… at any cost!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: It sounds like this is a much bigger issue for her than I first thought. I decide to lend a hand, however small, in her quest for composure.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Arf, arf! The name's Sakura Chihuahua O! Let's play fetch, Yaeno! Woof!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: Haaah… Rin pyo toh sha kai jin retsu zai zen… Guardians of those who do battle, protect me!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: And so, with the help of her friends, Yaeno Muteki trains to overcome cuteness…

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: I heard some puppies were born near the academy! Wanna go see 'em?

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: …No. I'm busy with my training, so I'm afraid I have to refuse.

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: Don't be like that! Watchin' adorable little puppies all huddled up for an afternoon nap is good for the soul!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: Ngh! I'm not going!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: Huh?! …Whazzup with her?

text_block_list.name: Baby Dolphin
text_block_list.text: Eek… Eek?

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: Look, they're super intrigued by you, Yaeno! Are you gonna be okay? You sure you can resist?!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: Y-yes, of course!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: …All right! That's three minutes! It's a new record!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Having grown tremendously, Yaeno Muteki is now ready to face the last hurdle.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: I see, so this is my final trial? …A cat cafe?

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: The trial that awaits beyond these doors is the equivalent of a G1 race in my eyes.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: Even so, my heart harbors no doubt.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: I'll tackle the cuteness head-on… I need only carry the pride of the Yaegaki style in my heart to emerge triumphant.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: While Yaeno Muteki is brimming with confidence, she seems still and collected. After what she's been through already, she should be able to overcome this final test with ease.

text_block_list.name: Feline Army
text_block_list.text: Meooow! ♪ Mrrreooow! ♪

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: I c-can't take it any longer!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: …Yet, she's unable to overcome the trial.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: Hm?! It's dangerous to climb so high! Quick, leap into my arms!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: Agh! Wolfing your food down like that could lead to choking! You need to take your time!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: Gyaaah! She jumped onto my lap! I-I have to protect her… I must protect her at all costs!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: As much as it pains me… I understand!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: Ahhh, this is truly heaven! None of these cats have a worry in the world. They're all just relaxing and enjoying life. What a sight!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: No matter what happens, I must ensure this tranquility is preserved!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Before long, Yaeno Muteki is even more mellowed out than the cats… It looks like not even the strictest training can help her overcome this weakness.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: Huh?! M-my… com…po…sure! Osu! Osu! OSU!

text_block_list.name: Kitten
text_block_list.text: Meow! Meow!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: Osu, osu, oshu, oshu-shu, ahhh! What's wrong, cutie? What are you nudging me for? There, there. Let me give you a hu—ah!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: Urgh, it's no use! I just can't overcome this Achilles' heel!
